창세기-1-1.title: 히브리어 문법 형태 '베레쉬트(בְּרֵאשִׁית)'의 상태론(State) 비평
창세기-1-1.note: The traditional rendering 'In the beginning' treats בְּרֵאשִׁית (bere'shit) as absolute, pointing to the absolute beginning of time and creation ex nihilo. Some scholars suggest a construct state ('In the beginning of God's creating...'), but grammatical syntax and ancient versions (LXX ἐν ἀρχῇ, Vulgate in principio) strongly support the absolute traditional translation.

마태복음-1-1.title: 표제어 '비블로스 게네세오스(βίβλος γενέσεως)'의 70인역 용례
마태복음-1-1.note: The Greek phrase βίβλος γενέ세ως (biblos geneseōs) echoes the Septuagint of Genesis 2:4 and 5:1. Matthew intentionally uses this Septuagintal phrasing to present Jesus Christ as the Inaugurator of the 'New Creation' and the culmination of Genesis history.

마태복음-1-18.title: 사본 이문: '탄생(γέννησις)' vs '기원/발생(γένεσις)'
마태복음-1-18.note: The early papyri (P1) and primary uncials (Sinaiticus, Vaticanus) read γένεσις (genesis, 'origin/beginning'), while later Byzantine minuscules read γέννησις (gennēsis, 'birth'). γένεσις is preferred as the more difficult reading, harmonizing with verse 1:1.

마태복음-1-23.title: 이사야 7:14 70인역(LXX) 인용: '파르테노스(παρθένος)' 비평
마태복음-1-23.note: Matthew explicitly follows the Septuagint (LXX) rendering παρθένος (parthenos, virgin) rather than the ambiguous Hebrew עַלְמָה ('almah, young maiden), underscoring the miraculous supernatural virgin conception.
